stepTitle: Scope OTP verification to the action being authorized
acceptanceCriteria: OTP proof cannot be reused across unrelated flows. Consent submit, public booking actions, and beach booking each require matching scoped verification. Existing OTP tests pass or are updated.

findings.summary: No SQL migration for the `scope` column on `otp_verifications`
findings.detail: The Drizzle schema (`apps/api/src/db/consent-schema.ts`) adds `scope: text('scope')` and an index, but no corresponding SQL migration file exists under `apps/api/drizzle/`. The journal (`_journal.json`) has no entry for a scope migration. Production deployment will fail or the column will not exist, causing all scoped OTP operations to break at runtime.

findings.summary: Mobile guest booking does not pass `verificationProof` or use scoped verification
findings.detail: The mobile app dispatches `SET_PHONE_VERIFIED` without a `verificationProof` (line 243) and `CreateBookingInput` in `apps/mobile/hooks/api/useBooking.ts:9` lacks a `verificationProof` field. Since `booking-action-routes.ts` now requires `data.verificationProof` for unauthenticated guests (falling through to `null` → `phone_not_verified`), all mobile guest bookings will be rejected with HTTP 400.

findings.summary: Consent proof test seeds OTP without `scope`, but consent verify route now requires scope match
findings.detail: The `createConsentVerificationProof` helper (line 48-65) inserts an OTP row with `scope: undefined` (null), then calls `/public/consent/${token}/verify`. The consent verify route now passes `scope: buildConsentOtpScope(token)` to `verifyPhoneOtpCode`, which queries `eq(scope, 'consent:v1:TOKEN')`. Since the seeded row has `scope=null`, the lookup will miss and the test will fail when run against a real database. The integration tests were all skipped (432 skip) due to missing `TEST_DATABASE_URL`, masking this failure.
